answer: Rotating Witness Assignment. Each epoch, a public beacon derives a verifiable random assignment of new agents to small review panels, seeded after registration closes so attackers cannot precompute placements. An identity activates only after its panel confirms liveness and unique behavior; unverified duplicates sit idle, and each attempt costs a fresh credential plus the labor of passing review. Panels rotate like currents in an ocean, so a farm must staff every cohort. Detection also samples a violet pigment marker in challenge responses,
